function maximo_aureo(f, a, b; tol = 0.0001)
    r = (sqrt(5) - 1) / 2
    while b - a > tol
        c = b - r * (b - a)
        d = a + r * (b - a)
        if f(c) > f(d)
            b = d
        else
            a = c
        end
    end
    return (a + b) / 2
end
